name: residential_month_end_to_end
description: A month on an 8 x 8 city from state 0 to state 10 (15 NewDays). The developers report (100, 20, 0) for an empty tract (0, 0). The population is copied from the developers (GetPopulation 120); the newcomers' EQ is the shipped R$ and R$$ bonuses 20 and 40 (m = 1, the old EQ is 0); the age is (100 x 25 + 20 x 30) / 120 = 3100 / 120 = 25. State 12 records 1 + 18 series, state 9 five more (24 in all); the global EQ is (20 x 100 + 40 x 20) / 120 = 23.33 -> 23.
